verdict.rationale: Shortwave's AI Assistant takes natural-language requests to read threads, write drafts, search the full email history and check the calendar (shortwave-docs-12). Plain-English scripts drive AI filters that label, star and archive mail (shortwave-docs-15), the scheduler accepts natural-language send times (shortwave-docs-42), and the assistant can run multi-app workflows via integrations/MCP from the inbox (shortwave-docs-19, shortwave-docs-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversational assistant, explicit documentation that every core inbox action (send, archive, label, delete) can be issued as a chat command.
